name: AV Causal Scenario Retrieval Challenge
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: Public challenge site, authenticated submission intake, personal status history, and leaderboard for the NVIDIA AV Causal Scenario Retrieval Challenge. The landing page at / presents the challenge overview; the focused participation page at /participate presents the public leaderboard first, followed by the registration/submission form and private submission history. /dataset and /terms are available only to authenticated participants whose team registration has been accepted. The public landing page deliberately omits dataset identity, download links, task splits, training examples, and…

The /dataset gate controls disclosure through the challenge frontend. The Official Terms identify the underlying dataset as publicly available, so this application cannot revoke direct access for someone who independently already knows an upstream public URL.
The Space is a Docker/FastAPI application. It keeps the original public HTML and CSS presentation while exposing same-origin participant APIs:
features: GET /api/me returns the current HF username, locked participant profile (if
POST /api/registrations accepts public team, private contactemail, and
POST /api/artifact-repositories creates or reconnects the participant's one
POST /api/submissions accepts public team, private contactemail, private
POST /api/submissions//ingest retries handoff of the existing immutable
